run_distill_bert_training: run DistilBERT training with knowledge distillation from a BERT teacher model via CLI
create_distiller_instance: create a Distiller instance with student, teacher, dataloader, and token probabilities for distillation
build_dataset_loader: build a Dataset data loader from binarized tokenized data and MLM token counts for training
load_student_model: load a DistilBertForMaskedLM student model from pretrained weights or fresh config
load_teacher_model: load a BertForMaskedLM teacher model from a pretrained BERT model name
